newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil firmer across the board at close.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil firmer across the board at close.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices finished the day mostly higher on bullish sentiment and strong fundamentals. Activities were mostly positions switching and unwinding ahead of the Chinese and Moslem festivals. More buying appeared when the April futures broke the 1,300 ringgit level.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market was also firmer on some refiners' covering ahead of the holidays.
Technically, third month April futures rose above the psychological level of 1,300 ringgit and the market is expected to hold firm at current levels.
Most-active third month April futures closed three ringgit higher at 1,305 ringgit ($523.78) a tonne.
Trading ranges are expected to remain narrow as players were reluctant to trade ahead of the long festive holidays.
The market is closed from February 6 to 11 for the Chinese Lunar New Year and Moslem Eid al-Fitr holidays.
"The market was quiet but firm because of the high export estimates for January," a trader said, adding that he expected double-digit percentage drop in production in January and February.
Physicals Feb (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,355 ringgit against bids at 1,350, after trading from 1,345 to 1,352.50.
Feb (central) was offered at 1,360 and bids at 1,355 with early trades at 1,350. Feb (north) was offered at 1,350 against 1,345.
Mar (south) saw offers at 1,350 with bids at 1,345, with early trades seen at 1,340 and 1,345. Mar (central) saw offers at 1,347.50 against bids at 1,337.50.
Among refined products, Feb RBD palm oil was offered at $567.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Mar at $562.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $552.50.
Feb RBD palm olein saw offers at $597.50, Mar at $595 and Apr/May/Jun at $585. Feb was traded at $595 and Apr at $585.
Feb/Mar RBD palm stearin was offered at $467.50 and Feb/Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $305.
